description: Save the active document in place, or at filePath in the format its extension names, with that format's options (File > Save As): PSD, PSB (Large Document Format), TIFF, PNG, JPEG, Photoshop PDF, GIF, Photoshop EPS, DCS 1.0 and 2.0 (.eps with epsType), BMP, Targa (.tga), Pixar (.pxr) or Photoshop Raw (.raw). With asCopy the document keeps referring to its own file

compression.description: TIFF: none, lzw (default), zip or jpeg. PNG: 0-9 (default 6)

embedColorProfile.description: Embed the colour profile (PSD, TIFF, JPEG, PDF, EPS, DCS). Default true

epsType.description: .eps files: Photoshop EPS (default), Photoshop DCS 1.0 or DCS 2.0 (CMYK documents; DCS 2.0 keeps spot channels)

filePath.description: Absolute path ending in .psd, .psb, .tif, .tiff, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .pdf, .gif, .eps, .bmp, .tga, .pxr, .raw. Omit to save in place

notes.description: PSD, TIFF, PDF: save the document's notes with it (the Notes save option)

options.description: More options for the format. TIFF: pixelOrder (interleaved|per_channel); byteOrder (ibm|mac); imagePyramid (true/false); layerCompression (rle|zip); jpegQuality (integer 0-12): with compression jpeg; spotColors (true/false). JPEG: matte (none|white|black|semigray|background|foreground|netscape): fill for transparent areas. Default none; scans (integer 3-5): progressive scans. PDF: viewAfterSaving (true/false): open the PDF afterwards. Default false; compatibility (1.3|1.4|1.5|1.6|1.7); description (text); embedThumbnail (true/false); optimizeForWeb (true/false); downsample (none|average|bicubic|subsample); downsampleTo (number 1-10000): ppi; downsampleAbove (number 1-10000): ppi; compression (none|zip|zip_4bit|jpeg|jpeg_low|jpeg_medium_low|jpeg_medium|jpeg_medium_high|jpeg_high|jpeg2000_low|jpeg2000_medium_low|jpeg2000_medium|jpeg2000_medium_high|jpeg2000_high|jpeg2000_lossless); jpegQuality (integer 0-12); tileSize (integer 32-1024): JPEG 2000 tile size; convertToEightBit (true/false); colorConversion (true/false); destinationProfile (text); includeProfile (true/false); downgradeColorProfile (true/false); outputCondition (text); outputConditionId (text); registryName (text); vectorData (true/false); embedFonts (true/false); useOutlines (true/false): text as outlines; interpolation (true/false); transparency (true/false); alphaChannels (true/false); spotColors (true/false). GIF: palette (exact|local_adaptive|local_perceptual|local_selective|master_adaptive|master_perceptual|master_selective|uniform|web|mac|windows|previous); colors (integer 2-256); forced (none|black_white|primaries|web); dither (none|diffusion|pattern|noise); ditherAmount (integer 1-100); transparency (true/false); matte (none|white|black|semigray|background|foreground|netscape); interlaced (true/false); preserveExactColors (true/false). EPS: preview (none|tiff_1bit|tiff_8bit|mac_1bit|mac_8bit|mac_jpeg); encoding (ascii|binary|jpeg_low|jpeg_medium|jpeg_high|jpeg_maximum); halftoneScreen (true/false); transferFunction (true/false); transparentWhites (true/false): Bitmap mode only; psColorManagement (true/false); vectorData (true/false); interpolation (true/false). DCS1: composite (none|grayscale|color); preview (none|tiff_1bit|tiff_8bit|mac_1bit|mac_8bit|mac_jpeg); encoding (ascii|binary|jpeg_low|jpeg_medium|jpeg_high|jpeg_maximum); halftoneScreen (true/false); transferFunction (true/false); vectorData (true/false); interpolation (true/false). BMP: osType (windows|os2); depth (1|4|8|16|24|32|a1r5g5b5|a4r4g4b4|a8r8g8b8|r5g6b5|r8g8b8|x1r5g5b5|x4r4g4b4|x8r8g8b8); rleCompression (true/false); flipRowOrder (true/false); alphaChannels (true/false). TARGA: bitsPerPixel (16|24|32); rleCompression (true/false); alphaChannels (true/false). PIXAR: alphaChannels (true/false). RAW: alphaChannels (true/false); spotColors (true/false). PSB: maximizeCompatibility (true/false): default true. DCS2: composite (none|grayscale|color); preview (none|tiff_1bit|tiff_8bit|mac_1bit|mac_8bit|mac_jpeg); encoding (ascii|binary|jpeg_low|jpeg_medium|jpeg_high|jpeg_maximum); halftoneScreen (true/false); transferFunction (true/false); vectorData (true/false); interpolation (true/false); multiFile (true/false): one file per channel; spotColors (true/false)

preset.description: PDF: Adobe PDF preset name, e.g. "[High Quality Print]"

name: save_document
title: Save Document
